build -p rjq
set -x
which python3 python; python3 --version; python3 -c "import sys; print(sys.executable, sys.platform)"
base="$(mktemp -d)"; echo "base=$base"
win_native="$(cygpath -w "$base")"; echo "native=$win_native"
mkdir -p "$base/reviewers/sess-1/plan"
printf '{"reviewer_session_id":"sess-1","overall_plan_approval":true}\n' > "$base/reviewers/sess-1/plan/approval.json"
: > "$base/lifecycle.jsonl"
mixed="$win_native/reviewers"
echo "mixed root: $mixed"
python3 benchmark/planning/lib-approval.py select-approval "$mixed" "$base/lifecycle.jsonl" "$base/sel-native.json"; echo "rc=$?"; cat "$base/sel-native.json"
python3 benchmark/planning/lib-approval.py select-approval "$base/reviewers" "$base/lifecycle.jsonl" "$base/sel-posix.json"; echo "rc=$?"; cat "$base/sel-posix.json"
python3 benchmark/planning/lib-approval.py select-approval "$(cygpath -m "$base")/reviewers" "$base/lifecycle.jsonl" "$base/sel-m.json"; echo "rc=$?"; cat "$base/sel-m.json"
python3 -c "
import sys
from pathlib import Path
for p in sys.argv[1:]:
    q = Path(p); print(repr(p), q.is_dir(), sorted(str(x) for x in q.glob('*/plan/approval.json')))
" "$mixed" "$base/reviewers" "$(cygpath -m "$base")/reviewers" "$win_native\\reviewers"
